subject: vt-dym
title: VT.DYM.------SOC.RT.
description: Chart on book p. 77 (CS-5). VT-DYM (vibrational dynamics) is the subject; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: TF, ALT-FT (alternative functionalism) and CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics). From TF: UPI-PI. From UPI-PI: C-CONT (composite continuance). From ALT-FT: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From SPT-DY: MOT-DY. From MOT-DY: POST (postulation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From CULT-INFO-DY: MT-INFO-DB. From MT-INFO-DB: AFI (affinity insight).
